title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Customer Success Specialist,Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.

  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure.   • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.

  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.

  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).

title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

description:

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:

About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

3. Project Delivery Timeliness

Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

• Atuar em projetos com alta volumetria operacional e ambientes com múltiplas integrações.


Competências Técnicas Requeridas

• Experiência sólida em Salesforce, com atuação em projetos de implementação e evolução da plataforma.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do Salesforce Field Service.

• Experiência com os seguintes componentes da solução: Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, mecanismos de Optimization e Dispatch.

• Experiência na modelagem de processos operacionais de Field Service.

• Conhecimento em integração de Salesforce com sistemas corporativos.

• Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e documentação funcional de soluções.

• Capacidade de análise de processos operacionais complexos e definição de melhorias sistêmicas.

Formação

Experiência

description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Position Overview


We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true \"Hybrid\" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar).   • Modern Frameworks: Expert use of UDOs (E1 Pages, Watchlists, Personalizations) and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a \"Technical-Functional Bridge,\" understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.


Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the \"connectors\" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.
