title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.
  • Assistência na cobrança: Responsável nas atividades de cobrança, entrando em contato com clientes para acompanhar pagamentos em atraso e resolver pendências. Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.


Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
  • Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas.
  • Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
AppXite is a product software development company, based in Riga, Latvia. Our Platform is an AI-Ready Digital Marketplace, CPQ & Billing Platform for Telco, SaaS, Cloud, and AI services. It enables partners to build and monetize as-a-service offerings with flexible pricing models. The platform includes pre-built vendor and catalog integrations with major providers like Microsoft, Google, AWS, Adobe, and VMware. It supports various billing configurations, helping partners effectively manage and grow their businesses.

About the role:   

We are seeking a dedicated Support Specialist for our largest global customers. You will undergo initial training in our platform, but should already possess qualifications necessary for the role. We’re looking for someone to grow with us in a remote position, working North America hours on a long-term B2B basis.

Your mission:   

  • Technical support and troubleshooting.  
  • Operational support tasks in the Application Support team working with Microsoft Cloud technologies .  
  • Experience with Microsoft CSP (Cloud Solution Provider) support and partner ecosystem processes.
  • Scope a customer issue by collecting the relevant facts and investigating the problem by doing his own research and by involving other teams as needed.  
  • Consult and collaborate with peers or colleagues around the world and with management and engineering to resolve service issues.  
  • Act internally as a customer/reseller advocate.  
  • Empower customers/resellers to find information, self-solve when they decide to, and learn more about Microsoft products, services, and support.  
  • Advise customers on how to gain additional value from their Microsoft products.  
  • Document technical work and research to help your colleagues to improve the product, and improve the support experience.  
  • Maintain a proactive approach to customer happiness, identifying customer satisfaction concerns and managing customer expectations.  
  • Having ownership of tasks, proactively following upon them, and ensuring fast resolution.  

That's you:   

  • Previous Support experience in IT.  
  • Strong SQL skills: ability to connect the database, ability to execute and create SQL queries.  
  • Hands-on experience working with APIs .  
  • Certified within Azure and/or M365 certification roadmap (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals or Associate level).
  • Fluent English (verbal and written).  
  • Experience with Microsoft Cloud technologies (Azure) .  
  • Experience with troubleshooting SaaS application is a plus.  
  • Experience with licensing and invoices is a plus.  
  • Experience with MS partner center or similar administrator portals is a plus.  
  • Ability to identify, update and create Help Center articles to assist team members and external users with navigating and using a product.  
  • Ability to work as part of a team.  
  • Ability to make quick decisions, align priorities and execute tasks.  
  • Be able to stay calm under pressure.  
  • Ability to communicate well and precisely.  


Why join AppXite:

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role.
  • Work With Global Tech Leaders: Collaborate on solutions used by some of the biggest names in the industry, including Adobe, AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, and Liquid. Your work will help shape how these companies deliver services across the globe.
  • Skilled, International Team: Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We value technical excellence, clear communication, and mutual support.
  • Professional Development: Advance your skills with access to Microsoft certifications and continuous learning opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy four weeks of paid vacation per year, plus paid public holidays.
  • Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team - our employee referral program recognizes and rewards your contributions.


Join AppXite Platform Engineering team and work with a talented group of engineers building out next-generation technologies!

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in C# and .NET to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:

  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP

  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:

This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories.   • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.

  • Data architecture concepts

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

We are seeking an experienced e-commerce Solution Architect to design, scale, and optimize modern digital commerce ecosystems. This role will be responsible for building secure, scalable, and high-performing architecture that supports enterprise-level eCommerce operations.

  • Experience integrating eCommerce platforms with ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture and analytics integrations, including Snowflake or similar platforms.

  • Experience with SMS, email marketing platforms, and customer reviews tools within the eCommerce ecosystem.

  • API & System Integrations
  • Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Cloud & Scalable Infrastructure

Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).

  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!

  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

Respond.io is expanding rapidly, aiming for a $1 billion valuation following our successful Series A funding. We seek a visionary Partnerships Manager to nurture and support our channel partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will drive mutual success through strong relationship management, strategic collaboration, and effective enablement.

  • Well-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and able to prioritize.
  • Ability to operate both at a strategic and hands-on level.
  • Fluent in Spanish, English & Portuguese with an ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • Nimble and agile team player with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Here's what's in for you

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges


Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!

Location: Remote – Brazil

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to build scalable backend systems and data services. Required Skills

  • Strong recent hands-on experience with Node.js .
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript .
  • Strong experience with MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Experience building REST APIs or GraphQL APIs .
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and database design .
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred) .
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and modern development practices .


Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL architecture or schema design .
  • Experience with distributed systems and high transaction platforms .
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data processing frameworks .
  • Experience working in digital media, sports, or high-scale consumer platforms .


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field , or equivalent practical experience.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :

With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.

Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace

  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
