  • Apoiar a formalização de contratos, aditivos e acordos comerciais.
  • Melhorar os fluxos dos processos de pré-vendas e elaboração de propostas.
  • Estruturar e fazer gestão de parcerias técnicas e comerciais com empresas que complementem nosso ecossistema de soluções.
  • Garantir que as informações das oportunidades em CRM (Pipedrive) e ferramentas de gestão (Monday) estejam atualizadas e corretas.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de pré-vendas, elaboração de propostas e gestão de oportunidades.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em estruturação de propostas técnico-comerciais para clientes B2B.

As a Master Data Support Analyst, you will provide functional and technical Level 2 support on the Master Data Management (MDM) platform, focusing on maintaining referential data objects using the EBX tool and associated middleware layers. You will act as a key liaison between global MDM teams, shared services centers, and Brazil-based business stakeholders, ensuring compliance with corporate and local Data Governance rules and standards. In addition to Level 2 support, you will participate in operational data quality initiatives, continuous improvement efforts, and user training, collaborating across departments to support efficient business operations and sustained data excellence. Service is provided in English.

Your missions:

  • Investigate and resolve master data integration issues by conducting detailed root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor overall data quality health and proactively propose, plan, and coordinate data cleansing campaigns aligned with Brazil-specific business rules and global data standards.
  • Perform advanced Level 2 troubleshooting, including middleware log analysis, payload simulation (SOAP UI, Postman), SQL querying, XML/JSON interpretation, and support of infrastructure operations when required.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for the EBX platform, providing guidance on configuration changes, enhancements, testing activities, and local customizations supporting the Brazil business model.
  • Enforce Data Governance rules and standards to ensure master data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems and functional domains.
  • Contribute to Non‑Regression Testing (NRT) campaigns, functional and integration testing, and continuous improvement initiatives linked to MDM processes and tooling.
  • Maintain, enhance, and document user guides, runbooks, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); actively participate in or deliver training sessions to promote best practices and user adoption.
  • Provide regular reporting on issue status, data quality metrics, cleansing campaigns, and project progress to the Service Delivery Manager and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with key users across Accounting, Trading, Credit, and other business domains to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, compliant MDM solutions aligned with Brazil’s business strategy.
  • Interface effectively with Level 1 support teams, global MDM leads, IT teams, and outsourced partners to ensure smooth operations, timely issue resolution, and high‑quality service delivery.

Your profile:

  • Solid background in Master Data Management, data quality, or user support.
  • Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts.
  • Familiarity with middleware tools, SOAP UI, Postman, SQL, XML, and JSON troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex issues and synthesize actionable insights.
  • Academic background: supply chain management, logistics, business administration, finance, or equivalent.
  • English fluent. Portuguese is a plus.
  • Knowledge of SDLC of an application.
  • Awareness of Brazil-specific regulatory, tax, and data protection requirements and ability to apply them to MDM practices.
  • Experience with API testing tools (SOAP UI, Postman) for payload simulation and testing.
  • Experience running and analyzing SQL queries.
  • Experience reading and interpreting XML and JSON files.
  • Experience with MDM platforms and tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring logs and data flow in middleware and integration layers.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow (SNOW), or similar for incident and problem management.
  • Experience with MS Tools and manipulating and analyzing data with Excel.
  • You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, a self-driven and customer-focused attitude, agility in learning, sound decision-making capabilities, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Flexibility to adapt to tight deadlines and a strong cross-cultural mindset for effective collaboration with global teams. Willingness to travel if necessary.

title: Product Designer - Pleno
description:

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.



Join our team at Native Teams, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact.


At Native Teams, we pride ourselves on our dynamic and supportive work environment, where we encourage personal and professional growth. We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.


As part of our team, you’ll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.


If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career and the chance to be part of a team that's making a real difference in the world, then we want to hear from you.


Apply now to join the Native Teams family and take the first step toward a brighter future!

title: MICE Travel Agent
description:

We offer

title: Analista de Telecom Latam - Metodologia TEM
description:
Analista de Telecom LATAM (Remoto) - Metodologia TEM

Sobre a Mobilit

A Mobilit é uma empresa especializada na gestão e redução de despesas de telecomunicações, com atuação em todo o Brasil e América Latina. Pioneira no país na aplicação do conceito TEM (Telecom Expense Management) , seguimos um padrão global que integra tecnologia e serviços para maximizar resultados.

Nosso modelo considera todo o ciclo de vida dos recursos de telecom — desde a contratação até o pagamento — passando por gestão logística, cadastral, de uso e suporte. Essa visão integrada proporciona maior controle, inteligência e eficiência na gestão.

Com mais de 20 anos de experiência e mais de R$ 400 milhões gerenciados anualmente , somos referência no mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na execução e no acompanhamento dos processos de gestão de telefonia móvel corporativa para países da América Latina, apoiando atividades de fechamento mensal, análise de inventário, gestão de linhas e equipamentos, renovações, compras, interface com operadoras e suporte às demandas das áreas internas, garantindo organização, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das informações.

Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar os processos de recebimento, validação e lançamento de faturas de telecom para pagamento relacionadas;
  • Apoiar na análise de desvios de gastos por países, top usuários e consolidação de informações para acompanhamento operacional;
  • Realizar a alocação (rateio) das despesas de telecom nos centros de custo, conforme critérios definidos;
  • Comunicar-se com operadoras para resolução de problemas de faturamento e negociação de prazos;
  • Manter comunicação contínua com clientes, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos de lançamento de faturas e notas fiscais;
  • Atender demandas de service desk relacionadas à telefonia móvel, incluindo:
  • Ativação, cancelamento, bloqueio e suspensão de linhas;
  • Controle de recebimento/devolução de equipamentos por país;
  • Controle de assinatura de termos;
  • Solicitação de novas linhas e/ou aparelhos;
  • Processo de MUREG (Mudança de DDD);
  • Transferência de titularidade, entre outros;
  • Realizar análises semestrais para identificação de oportunidades de otimização, como novos planos, troca de operadora, revisão de serviços e renovação de parque.
  • Apoiar o processo de compra de novos equipamentos e linhas, acompanhando solicitações e controles internos;
  • Preparar documentação necessária para operadoras e apoiar interação com áreas responsáveis por aprovações e assinaturas.
  • Apoiar processos de cotação, priorização de demandas e follow-up com fornecedores.
  • Interagir com times internos, fornecedores e operadoras para garantir andamento das demandas.
  • Sugerir melhorias de processo e apoiar iniciativas de organização da operação LATAM.


  • Auditar faturas de telecom, identificando erros de cobrança;
  • Realizar contestações e garantir o ressarcimento de valores pagos indevidamente;
  • Realizar o cadastro e a gestão detalhada do inventário de telecom (linhas móveis, fixas e circuitos de dados), garantindo a eficiência na gestão dos recursos;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em telecomunicações;
  • Experiência com os sistemas Service Now, SAP, Ariba e plataformas de TEM (Telecom Expense Management).
  • Espanhol fluente;
  • Vivência com controle de demandas, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alto volume de informações e múltiplas demandas simultâneas
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel (nível intermediário a avançado);
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Telecomunicações ou Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas.


Perfil do candidato

  • Foco em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Habilidade de relacionamento com públicos internos e externos (clientes e operadoras);
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias de processos e propor soluções;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Paciência e resiliência na resolução de problemas;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com gestão de despesas de telecom em ambiente corporativo;
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de faturas e múltiplos centros de custo;

Informações adicionais

Salário:

  • R$ 3.289,53

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação / Vale refeição
  • Convênio médico e odontológico (após efetivação)
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • TotalPass (benefício para academias e bem-estar)

Informações adicionais

  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (deve residir em São Paulo, SP)
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 8h30 às 17h30

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Java - Sênior

title: Sr. Recruiter
description:
About the job


JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).



Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Analista de Tesouraria Jr (Crédito e Cobrança)
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Acompanhar e analisar status de ordens bloqueadas para faturamento, a fim de identificar e avaliar as informações que estejam impactando na liberação, bem como atuar nas ações necessárias para desbloqueio.
  • Realizar o processo de cobrança junto a clientes inadimplentes, negociando a regularização dos títulos em aberto.


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;

  • Conhecimento das técnicas de cobrança, técnicas de negociação e em matemática financeira (ex.: cálculos de juros/encargos, projeções de crédito e caixa);
  • Vivência em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA, para vaga temporária(licença maternidade);

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with deep expertise in Large Language Model integration and production AI systems. This role will lead the design and implementation of LLM-powered capabilities within our platform, working closely with backend, mobile, and product teams.

This individual will own the end-to-end AI architecture, from model selection and prompt strategy to retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, cost optimization, and production deployment.

This is not a research role. It is a systems architecture and applied AI engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, real-world AI applications.

Key Responsibilities

LLM Architecture & Integration

  • Design and implement LLM-powered application workflows
  • Architect prompt orchestration, tool calling, and multi-step reasoning pipelines
  • Define model selection strategy (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.)
  • Implement streaming responses for mobile and web clients
  • Optimize token usage and latency for production environments
  • Build fallback and resilience strategies across model providers

RAG & Knowledge Systems

  • Architect retrieval-augmented generation pipelines
  • Design vector database schema and embedding workflows
  • Implement chunking, metadata tagging, and indexing strategies
  • Optimize semantic search relevance
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data sources

AI Infrastructure & Backend Integration

  • Collaborate with backend architects to integrate AI services into APIs
  • Design asynchronous processing pipelines for AI workflows
  • Implement caching strategies for inference results
  • Architect evaluation and monitoring frameworks for LLM output quality
  • Build guardrails, moderation layers, and output validation

Model Evaluation & Performance

  • Define evaluation metrics for response quality
  • Implement automated testing for LLM outputs
  • Analyze hallucination patterns and mitigation techniques
  • Monitor drift, cost, and performance metrics
  • Continuously improve prompt and architecture strategies

Security & Governance

  • Implement data privacy safeguards
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security requirements
  • Design safe handling of user-generated content
  • Implement access control and audit logging

Technical Leadership

  • Guide LLM architecture decisions across the platform
  • Mentor engineers working on AI-related components
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks
  • Define long-term AI roadmap aligned with product strategy

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years in software engineering with at least 2+ years focused on LLM systems
  • Production experience integrating LLM APIs
  • Strong experience with:
  • Python (FastAPI preferred)
  • Vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Embeddings and semantic search
  • Prompt engineering and tool invocation workflows
  • Experience building RAG systems in production
  • Experience optimizing latency and inference costs
  • Strong understanding of tokenization, context windows, and model limitations
  • Experience deploying AI services in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
  • Experience with evaluation tooling and benchmarking
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning or model adaptation techniques
  • Experience building AI features for mobile-first applications

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.

  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders; providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.

  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.

You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.


Diversity & Inclusion


Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

description:

title: Coordenador(a) de SSMA (Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de SSMA (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente) para atuar de forma estratégica em uma agroindústria em expansão, com operações em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Essa posição terá papel fundamental na estruturação e padronização da gestão de SSMA , garantindo conformidade legal, mitigação de riscos e fortalecimento da cultura de segurança.


Principais desafios:

  • Estruturar o modelo de gestão de SSMA em múltiplas unidades.
  • Garantir aderência às normas e requisitos legais.
  • Liderar a agenda de gestão de riscos e segurança operacional.
  • Fortalecer a cultura de segurança e desenvolver lideranças.
  • Atuar integrado às áreas de manutenção e operação na avaliação técnica de estruturas e adequações de segurança.
  • Estruturar, revisar e manter atualizada toda a documentação legal de SST, garantindo conformidade legal.
  • Gerir programas legais como PGR, LTCAT, PPP, PCMSO, Laudos de Insalubridade e Periculosidade, Prevenção e Combate à Incêndio, entre outros aplicáveis.
  • Desenvolver, planejar e executar treinamentos técnicos internos, e capacitação, com foco na formação e reciclagem de operadores, atendentendo às NRs, promovendo autonomia operacional e adequações à segurança.
  • Conduzir projetos técnicos de segurança física (sistemas de proteção contra quedas, linhas de vida, pltaformas e acessos, trabalhos em altura e confinados).
  • Atuar na construção de uma cultura de segurança, com foco em prevenção, responsabilidade compartilhada e comportamento seguro.
  • Realizar inspeções de campo, auditorias internas e acompanhamento de planos de ação.


Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil, com especialização em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Vivência em ambiente industrial. Será um diferencial experiência em Armazém de Grãos.
  • Conhecimento sólido das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs), especialmente NR-01, NR-06, NR-11, NR-12, NR-17, NR-23, NR-35, entre outras aplicáveis.
  • Experiência com elaboração e gestão de documentação legal de SST.
  • Será um diferencial vivência em ambientes em estruturação.
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Porto Nacional – TO, com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes à Canarana – Mato Grosso, São Paulo e outras localidades necessárias.

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS SAP TM
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade


ATIVIDADES

  • Realizar o suporte as áreas de Supply chain, garantindo a correta execução de seus processos;
  • Fazer alinhamentos e governanças dos atendimentos de chamados com as áreas clientes e TI, buscando melhoras o suporte realizado as áreas de negócio;
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade técnica, bem como especificações funcionais e técnicas para soluções de tratativas de causa raiz para erros sistêmicos;
  • Acompanhar os status das demandas e realizar follow-up dos planos de ação, garantindo a execução dos testes pelas áreas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com nossos clientes para entender suas necessidades específicas e encontrar as melhores soluções dentro do módulo SAP TM.
  • Apoiar key users, conduzindo treinamentos e orientação funcional.


REQUISITOS

  • Graduação em TI, Ciências da Computação ou Análise de Sistemas;
  • Necessário:
  • Conhecimento em suporte ao módulo SAP TM (Transportation Management)
  • Experiência em suporte AMS no módulo TM nos processos de Planejamento de Fretes através do Sistema SAP TM;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado nos processos de Planejamento de transporte, Freight Order, Freight Agreement e Charge Calculation.
  • Diferencial:
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de desenvolvimento BOPF;
  • Experiência no suporte ao módulo SAP LES/TRA;
  • Conhecimento nas diferentes versões do módulo TM (S4/Hanna);


✅ Benefícios que fazem a diferença:

  • Plano de Saúde

title: Orçamentista
description:

title: Consultor de peças e serviços
description:
Sobre a Empresa



A ALIS, é uma concessionária DAF no estado do Mato Grosso desde 2013. Nossa missão é Fazer o transporte acontecer. O Transporte está em nosso DNA, por isso nosso dia a dia é compreender e acolher o cliente em suas necessidades; Para nós ser lucrativo nos possibilita reinvestir e crescer o negócio de forma sustentável; Acreditamos que fazer mais com menos, é ser criativo e gerar inovações; Mantemos o foco em evoluir pessoas e negócios, com desenvolvimento e valorização; Buscamos o compliance.

Prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios;

Garantir a satisfação e fidelização dos clientes;

Trabalhar em conjunto com oficina, logística e área técnica.



Qualificações


•Ensino médio completo;

•Experiência anterior em vendas, negociação e prospecção;

•Boa comunicação e organização;

•Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e interagir com diferentes áreas;

  • Experiência em concessionária de caminhões ou veículos pesados;

Salário fixo + comissão compatível com o mercado;

Treinamentos técnicos e comerciais (internos e via montadora);

Seguro de vida;

Vale alimentação;

Auxilio combustível;

Plano de Saúde Unimed;

Convênio com o SESC.


Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades



Na ALIS construímos relações baseadas no respeito, respeitamos as diferenças sociais, culturais, de línguas, entre outras e valorizamos a soma de todas elas. Não admitimos nenhuma conduta contrária nesse sentido.

Em nosso ambiente a diversidade e inclusão é incentivada e valorizada como uma fonte de riqueza para as relações, as atividades e o negócio.
